title: Claude Team Plan (2026 Guide)
summary: Claude Team plan pricing charges per seat with specific features; compare the rates and capabilities against Pro to determine the best fit for your team.
body_markdown:
## Compare Claude Team plan pricing and features


### Claude Team plan pricing summary for small teams


When a seat hits its usage limit, you get pushed toward a pricier tier. Claude Team is the per-seat plan for groups, so your bill scales with headcount, even if some people, say those who only[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) workflows touch occasionally, barely use their seat.


It happens fast on the individual ladder. Free costs $0 per month on[Claude](https://claude.com/pricing) 's pricing page, with limited usage every 5 hours and every week, so it suits a trial and not a working day.


According to Claude's pricing page, **Pro is $20 per month** , which is the baseline every Team seat gets compared against.


Max is $100 per month according to Claude, **five times Pro** , so one heavy user who outgrows Pro costs as much as five Pro seats. Ultra is $200 per month, so a few power users can outspend the rest of a small team combined.


### Every current plan in one table


Read the table below for one thing: only Team and Enterprise are designed for a group, and the other three charge one person. It sets all five plans side by side, letting you compare them directly.


Plan Monthly price Billed per Stated limit


Free $0 Person Limited usage every 5 hours and every week; up to 5 Projects


Pro $20 Person Higher usage than Free


Max From $100 Person Higher usage than Pro


Team Per seat, listed on the pricing page Seat Usage allowance per seat


Enterprise $20 per seat, billed annually (20 seat minimum) Contract Agreed with Anthropic


*Prices and plan limits checked against[docs.claude.com](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/about-claude/models/overview) and[claude.com](https://claude.com/pricing) and[openai.com](https://openai.com/chatgpt/pricing) and[gemini.google](https://gemini.google/subscriptions) on October 30, 2026.*

If the limits column looks vague, that is on purpose. Anthropic states usage as allowances that reset, so a seat that looks cheap can still stall mid-task at 4 p.m. That's the cost to measure, and the rest of this article shows how.


### What Team adds that Pro does not have


With Team you get group management: one bill for everyone and admin control over who has a seat. Pro is a personal account, so with ten Pro subscribers you reconcile ten expense lines and have no central view of who is stuck at their limit.


That missing view is the problem, and headcount pricing is what produces it: every seat is a line item, so IT hands out a few and everyone else waits.


**Per-seat pricing rations automation** , and[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) doesn't: it meters credits by use and ships unlimited flows on every plan, so adding a person costs nothing until they run something, within the user count each plan includes (up to 5 users on Free and Plus).


Each team works in its own project, with only the apps an admin has allowed and credentials held centrally. Alan and Funding Societies run production automation on it, and the credit structure is on its pricing page.
